Hi Sofia / Liam 


Great to meet earlier 



thanks for the time. Per our call, attaching a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the security review and SOC 2 package milestone. High level recap below and ask for confirmation on the dates/owners.

Call recap:
- Objective: Aurelia Tech to complete vendor security review and obtain internal approval to proceed with a POC by EoQ.
- Key outcome required: SOC 2 artifacts (questionnaire responses + evidence) delivered to Aurelia secops for review.

Attached: redwood-map-draft-v1.pdf (MAP with milestones), redwood-soc2-questionnaire.xlsx (blank questionnaire), redwood-evidence-list.pdf (suggested evidence and examples).

Proposed MAP milestone (security review / SOC 2 package):
- Deliverable: Completed SOC 2 questionnaire + evidence bundle (logs, config screenshots, policy docs).
- Target delivery date: 2026-10-20 (we can adjust based on your internal timelines).
- Redwood responsibilities: Provide completed questionnaire template, evidence list, SOC 2 control mappings, and a 1-hour walkthrough with Dev (SE) to speed collection.
- Aurelia responsibilities: Identify internal reviewer(s), gather requested evidence, and return completed questionnaire.
- Dependencies: Access to your security mailbox and a short call with your SecOps to align on evidence format.

Next steps / asks:
1) Please confirm that the target date 2026-10-20 is feasible for your team.
2) Confirm who will own evidence collection on Aurelia side (name + email).
3) Let me know 2 x 30-min windows next week for a technical walkthrough (Dev will join).

Thanks 


Best,
Marissa Cole

Thanks Marissa 


A quick note from our side:
- I'll own the coordination internally and will be Aurelia's primary contact for the SOC 2 package (sofia.kline@aurelia-tech.com).
- The proposed target of 2026-10-20 is optimistic but doable if we get a clean questionnaire and clear evidence checklist.
- Our SecOps requests a CSV-style evidence index (filename + control mapped + timestamp) to speed ingestion. Can you include that or should we adapt your evidence-list?

Two requests:
1) Can Dev join a walkthrough next week (we prefer 10/07 or 10/08, 10:00–11:00 PT)?
2) Please flag any items that require privileged access (we may need to redact or provide screenshots instead).

I'll start pulling folks together and confirm the reviewer names by EoD tomorrow.
